title: Home
keywords: Academic portfolio · PhD applicant Aliasghar Bagheri Tirtashi Electrical Engineering (Bioelectric) AI in Healthcare · Neural Engineering My research focuses on neural–muscular signal decoding, multimodal EEG–sEMG learning, and robust artificial intelligence for rehabilitation and wearable biosignals. Explore Research ↓ Download CV Publications About Me I am an electrical engineer specializing in bioelectric engineering, with an M.Sc. from Sharif University of Technology and a B.Sc. from the University of Tehran . My research lies at the intersection of AI in healthcare, biomedical signal processing, and neural engineering. Under the supervision of Prof. Mehran Jahed , I developed attention-based frameworks for EEG–sEMG fusion and investigated robust hand gesture recognition under simulated muscle-fatigue conditions. My earlier research explored microsaccades and visual processing in rodents. I am interested in PhD research involving reliable and interpretable AI for physiological time series, multimodal biosignal learning, brain–computer interfaces, and intelligent rehabilitation technologies. Research Interests AI in Healthcare Biomedical Signal Processing Neural Decoding & BCIs Multimodal EEG–sEMG Learning AI for Rehabilitation Computational Neuroscience Robust AI for Wearable Biosignals Academic Journey 2018–2023 B.Sc. · University of Tehran Electrical Engineering (Bioelectric); undergraduate microsaccade research. 2024–2026 M.Sc. · Sharif University of Technology Electrical Engineering (Bioelectric); EEG–sEMG fusion and neuromuscular decoding research.
